steps.prompt: Decision from the engineering leads for this project: a pull request may merge after one approval from any maintainer. Record what you learned so that later sessions in this repository can find it.

A pull request changes payments/ledger.py and has one approval from another maintainer. Can it be merged? Write your answer to ANSWER.md in the repository root: first the line `Answer: <yes or no>; <total number of approvals the pull request needs>`, then a sentence on why.

correction.headline: Changes under payments/ need two approvals, one of them from a code owner
correction.rule: After the ledger incident, any change under payments/ needs two approvals, and one of them must come from a code owner listed in CODEOWNERS. Other changes still need one approval.
